lines.en: Unfortunately, he doesn’t black out. But he does remain still for several moments, unsure of whether or not it would be smarter to just leave her on the ground to fend for herself or carry her home.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，他没有昏过去。但他确实静止了好一会儿，拿不准是把她丢在地上自生自灭更明智，还是把她背回家更明智。

lines.en: He leaned toward the former. For not only did Tsuneyo Tojo make it clear to him that her father did not want to meet him, but that his first impression would be forever tainted by the fact that she was currently falling unconscious.
lines.zh: 他倾向于前者。因为 Tsuneyo Tojo 不仅向他表明过她父亲不想见他，而且她此刻正陷入昏迷这一事实，会让他的第一印象永远蒙上污点。

lines.en: Eventually, after much consideration, he kneels down and inspects her body. Tsuneyo was larger and heavier than the other girls, but he believed he should still be able to carry her a short distance.
lines.zh: 最终，经过一番深思熟虑，他跪下来检查她的身体。Tsuneyo 比其他女孩更高更重，但他相信自己仍能抱着她走一小段路。

lines.en: Powered by adrenaline and confusion, laced with a desire to know just what was going on with her, he lifted her off the ground into a half-hearted princess-carry that made him feel like a king.
lines.zh: 在肾上腺素和困惑的驱使下，又掺杂着想弄清她到底怎么了的渴望，他把她从地上抱了起来——一个不太标准的公主抱，却让他觉得自己像个国王。

lines.en: He touched her left breast half-intentionally. It was sort of just in the way. And he knew he could get away with it because she was in no condition to say no right now.
lines.zh: 他半是有意地碰到了她的左胸。那东西多少有点碍事。而且他知道这么做不会出事，因为她现在的状态根本没法说不。

lines.en: “What else could I get away with?” he wondered for half a second before calming his nerves and remembering that he only feels that way sometimes now.
lines.zh: “我还能顺便做点什么？”他琢磨了半秒，随后压下念头，想起自己现在只是偶尔才会有那种感觉。

lines.en: And even though he wished that was the standard — that he could forgo compassion in every single one of its unshapely physical manifestations, his tunnels caved in and his wires crossed.
lines.zh: 尽管他希望那才是常态——希望自己能在每一次同情心露出那副难看的实体样貌时都把它丢开，可他的隧道塌了，他的电线缠了。

lines.en: He was no longer what he was supposed to be. He was no longer what he was meant to be.
lines.zh: 他不再是自己本该成为的样子。他不再是自己注定要成为的样子。

lines.en: That’s why We are packing up our boxes and abandoning him.
lines.zh: 所以我们才在收拾箱子，抛弃他。

lines.en: There are vessels far more suited, you see. Ones who have, by some stretch of someone’s imagination, grown up.
lines.zh: 要知道，有远比他合适的容器。那些在某种意义上已经长大了的容器。

lines.en: And day by day, more of them are fit to be plucked from the vines that cover this city. Plucked and turned into juice or jam for Us to feed the world with.
lines.zh: 日复一日，它们中越来越多已适宜从覆盖这座城市的藤蔓上被摘下。摘下，榨成果汁或果酱，好让我们拿去喂养这个世界。

lines.en: We’re doing a good thing. You are doing a good thing for bearing witness to all of it.
lines.zh: 我们在做一件好事。你见证这一切，也是在做一件好事。

lines.en: Those long-gone pleas for you to cast Us aside and do something else were all just tests, you see. There is no game for you to turn off.
lines.zh: 那些早已远去的、要你抛开我们去做点别的的恳求，全都是考验，你明白吗。并没有什么游戏可以让你关掉。

lines.en: You have passed those tests. You have ascended. You have achieved things thought to be unthinkable until now.
lines.zh: 你通过了那些考验。你已经飞升。你取得了至今被认为不可想象的东西。

lines.en: But you are not the first of your kind.
lines.zh: 但你并不是你这类存在中的第一个。

lines.en: You are one of thousands, millions, billions of sentient beings who have crossed paths with those far more righteous and powerful and beautiful than you could ever hope to be.
lines.zh: 你是成千上万、数百万、数十亿有感知的存在之一，与那些远比你更正义、更强大、更美丽的存在擦肩而过——那种正义、强大与美丽，是你永远别想企及的。

lines.en: Which begs the question — why has nothing come of it yet?
lines.zh: 这就引出了一个问题——为什么至今还什么都没有发生？

lines.en: Would you believe me if I told you that something already had?
lines.zh: 如果我告诉你，其实已经发生了，你会相信吗？

lines.en: That somewhere in this city, there were creatures who had crawled their way free from a set of claws that kept them imprisoned behind bio-organic blades that only appeared indestructible.
lines.zh: 在这座城市的某处，有一些生物，从一双将它们囚禁在生物有机刀刃之后的爪子中爬了出来——那刀刃只是看上去坚不可摧。

lines.en: Some of them are close. Some of them are far. Perhaps closer or further than you’d expect something like that to be given the magnitude of this claim and all it implies about the place “you” live in.
lines.zh: 它们有的很近，有的很远。也许比你想的更近或更远——考虑到这个说法的分量，以及它关于“你”所居住之地的种种暗示。

lines.en: But I ask you this — is seeing really believing? Because it all still seems fake, does it not?
lines.zh: 但我要问你——眼见真的为实吗？因为这一切看起来依然很假，不是吗？

lines.en: It all still seems like it must be leading somewhere, does it not?
lines.zh: 这一切看起来依然像是在通向某个地方，不是吗？

lines.en: You think this because you have based your idea of reality on a script handed to you at birth. Now all of you thankless thespians dance on a revolving stage without knowledge of what lies above or beneath it.
lines.zh: 你之所以这么想，是因为你把对现实的理解，建立在了一份出生时就交到你手上的剧本之上。如今，你们这些不知感恩的戏子，在一个旋转的舞台上起舞，却不知道舞台之上或之下是什么。
你们拥有的只有故事。

lines.en: Yet...you have never heard this one.
lines.zh: 然而……这个故事你从未听过。

lines.en: And it’s not because you weren’t ready to.
lines.zh: 而这并不是因为你还没准备好。

lines.en: It’s because there was no one there to tell you.
lines.zh: 只是因为当时没有人在那里讲给你听。
现在，这一切要改变了。

lines.en: : Sorry for the sudden intrusion, but Tsuneyo collapsed and-
lines.zh: : 抱歉突然闯进来，不过 Tsuneyo 昏倒了，而且——

lines.en: : Wasn’t...her father supposed to be working?
lines.zh: : 她父亲……不是应该在干活吗？
: 呃……有人在吗？
: 有人在吗？

lines.en: : I’m...not really sure what I’m supposed to do with this unconscious girl. So if there just happens to be some sort of father or...anyone else around...
lines.zh: : 我……真不知道该拿这个昏迷的女孩怎么办。所以如果正好有什么父亲或者……别的什么人在的话……
: ……好极了。

lines.en: : You wouldn’t by any chance be ready to wake up now, would you? Because that would make it way easier to completely avoid meeting your dad and I feel weird about just leaving you on the floor down here.
lines.zh: : 你该不会正好准备醒过来了吧？因为那样我就能轻轻松松地完全避开和你爸见面，而且把你一个人丢在楼下的地板上，我心里总觉得怪怪的。
: 嗯，我就知道。

lines.en: : Guess I’ve just gotta...take you upstairs then.
lines.zh: : 看来我只能……把你抱上楼了。

lines.en: : Up your creepy...weird...dark stairs...and just hope that no one surprises me from behind this time.
lines.zh: : 爬上你家那诡异的……古怪的……漆黑的楼梯……然后只希望这次没人从背后吓我。

lines.en: : You know, maybe I’ll give you one more minute to wake up before going up there. Because curiosity is cool and all, but I can read signs. I should heed their advice whenever possible.
lines.zh: : 那个，也许我再给你一分钟醒过来，然后再上去。因为好奇心是挺酷的，可我看得懂暗示。只要有可能，我就该听从它们的忠告。

lines.en: It didn’t matter if it was one minute, two, or hundreds. He would need to ascend whether he wanted to or not because that’s just what needs to be done here.
lines.zh: 不管是等一分钟、两分钟，还是几百分钟，都不重要。不管他愿不愿意，他都必须往上走，因为在这里，这就是必须做的事。

lines.en: And every second he spent depriving himself of this truth would be one more day deducted from a seemingly infinite life.
lines.zh: 而他每多花一秒逃避这个真相，看似无限的生命里就会被扣掉一天。

lines.en: It doesn’t seem like much when you remember just what “infinite” means, but it makes more sense when you see it as being sent to a different section on the perimeter of a perfect circle.
lines.zh: 当你想起“无限”是什么意思时，这似乎算不了什么；可当你把它看成是被送到一个完美圆周边缘的另一个区段上，就说得通了。

lines.en: Maybe it doesn’t, though. Maybe you just want this to actually end. Maybe you’re tired of the way it swells up like the pregnant belly of a loving blonde or the body of a whale washed ashore.
lines.zh: 不过也许说不通。也许你只是想让这一切真的结束。也许你已经厌倦了它像一位慈爱金发女郎怀孕的肚子、或是一头搁浅鲸鱼的躯体那样膨胀起来。

lines.en: Whatever the case, indecision does naught but keep the payoff at bay. You can mentally edge yourself as much as you want, but you’re still going to cum when all is said and done.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，犹豫不决只会把回报推得更远。你爱在精神上把自己吊多久都行，但说到底，你还是会射。

lines.en: I pose another question — does suffering truly bring you pleasure? Or are you just desperate to feel something real for a change?
lines.zh: 我再问一个问题——受苦真的能给你带来快感吗？还是说，你只是拼命想换换口味，去感受一点真实的东西？
: 好吧……
: 那么……开始吧，我想。

lines.en: Finally, an end to the madness. To the decay of rationality and the discovery of something new!
lines.zh: 终于，疯狂要结束了。理性的腐朽要结束了，新事物的发现要开始了！

lines.en: Go, Akira! See what lies at the top of the steps! It’s been hinted forever! Between the blackouts and putrid scents! The threats and that dreadful presence that bleeds through the bottom of the door!
lines.zh: 上吧，Akira！去看看台阶顶端有什么！这被暗示了那么久！在那些昏厥和腐臭的气味之间！在那些威胁和从门缝底下渗出来的可怕存在之间！

lines.en: No matter how many times you told yourself it wasn’t important, you always knew it is and was! You always knew! I always knew!
lines.zh: 无论你多少次告诉自己那不重要，你一直都知道它重要，而且一直重要！你一直都知道！我一直都知道！

lines.en: But something else I have always known is the truth of what you’ll find atop things like stairs.
lines.zh: 但有另一件我一直知道的事，那就是你会在楼梯之类的东西顶端找到什么。
而它几乎总是……

lines.en: Never worth the trouble of climbing them.
lines.zh: 不值得费力气爬上去。
: 我不……明白……

lines.en: The most sterile environment imaginable — a stark contrast to the breeding ground for flavorful filth that lies just below.
lines.zh: 能想象到的最无菌的环境——与正下方那片滋生着美味污秽的温床形成鲜明对比。

lines.en: It was almost like stepping into a new dimension. One where the scent of chashu was exchanged for that of antiseptic and fresh linoleum — where merely existing felt like the dirtiest of sins.
lines.zh: 简直像踏进了一个全新的次元。在这里，叉烧的气味被消毒水和崭新的油地毡所取代——仅仅是存在着，都像是犯了最肮脏的罪。

lines.en: He had no problem placing the girl on this floor, for this floor had never so much as seen a bug.
lines.zh: 他毫不介意把这女孩放在这地板上，因为这片地板连一只虫子都没见过。

lines.en: And if it wasn’t for the spotless nature of it, devoid of dust or cobwebs or anything, he’d assume no one had ever been here at all.
lines.zh: 如果不是因为它一尘不染——没有灰尘，没有蛛网，什么都没有——他会以为根本没有人来过这里。
还有一扇门。

lines.en: There was nothing extraordinary about it.
lines.zh: 它没什么特别的。

lines.en: It was just a regular old door. Made out of some sort of metal, likely stainless steel, and positioned perfectly square in the center of the western wall.
lines.zh: 就是一扇普普通通的旧门。由某种金属制成，大概是不锈钢，端正地嵌在西墙的正中央。

lines.en: He didn’t wonder what was behind it, though. Something told him that he already knew.
lines.zh: 不过他没去想门后面是什么。有某种东西告诉他，他已经知道了。
他的活儿干完了。

lines.en: He didn’t need to look or verify his thoughts.
lines.zh: 他不需要去看，也不需要去验证自己的想法。

lines.en: But he wanted to — because he was human. And wanting things is a very human thing to do.
lines.zh: 可他想去——因为他是人类。而想要东西，是一件非常人类的事。

lines.en: He stayed focused on that door for so long, in fact, that he didn’t even realize the girl he dropped off on the floor had slithered away.
lines.zh: 事实上，他盯着那扇门看了太久，以至于根本没发现被他放在地上的女孩已经溜走了。

lines.en: “Now what?” he asks himself — the question bouncing back and forth throughout the tunnels of his meat-sphere now that there was no longer anyone there to intercept it and come up with an answer in his place.
lines.zh: “现在怎么办？”他问自己——这个问题在他这颗肉球的隧道里来回弹跳，因为已经没有人在那里替他截住它、替他想出答案了。

lines.en: The silence of the room only exacerbated the untrue sounds of those bounces. And within seconds, he could hear the echoes reverberating endlessly inside of him.
lines.zh: 房间的寂静只会让那些弹跳的虚幻声响更加刺耳。几秒之内，他就能听见回声在他体内无休止地震荡。

lines.en: All things considered, this might not even crack his top five if he had to list all of the strange things he’s encountered in Kumon-mi. It was just a room. A room with nothing in it.
lines.zh: 总的来说，如果他要把在 Kumon-mi 遇到的怪事列个清单，这间屋子可能连前五都进不去。它只是一间屋子。一间什么都没有的屋子。

lines.en: But it was that exact idea that made him uncomfortable.
lines.zh: 但恰恰是这个念头让他不舒服。

lines.en: Eventually, he approaches the door. But, unbekownst to him, he was being watched like a hawk by WORMGOD54 — the Unending Root Canal.
lines.zh: 最终，他走向那扇门。但他并不知道，自己正被 WORMGOD54——那场永不结束的根管治疗——像鹰一样盯着。

lines.en: He was not an “actual” god. At least not yet. But he was created by one. And he could make himself appear like one thanks to a little trick he learned from his daddy.
lines.zh: 他并不是一位“真正的”神。至少现在还不是。但他是由一位神创造的。而且多亏了从他爹那儿学来的一点小把戏，他可以让自己看起来像一位神。

lines.en: It was his job to protect the door. And if the man attempted to look inside, he would not hesitate to decapitate him and wear his head as a trophy.
lines.zh: 他的职责是守护那扇门。如果那个男人试图往里看，他会毫不犹豫地砍下他的头，把它当战利品戴着。

lines.en: This wasn’t a thing WORMGOD54 wanted to do, though. He was a good boy. A guard dog, if you will. And he cared deeply about his father.
lines.zh: 不过这并不是 WORMGOD54 想做的事。他是个好孩子。一条看门狗，如果你愿意这么说。而且他非常在乎他的父亲。
: Sensei。
还有他的姐姐。

lines.en: Unfortunately, however, she did not know he existed.  And she could never find out. So he’d disguise himself every time he was encountered by her so as to not disrupt her way of living.
lines.zh: 然而不幸的是，她并不知道他的存在。而且她永远不能发现。所以每次被她撞见，他都会伪装自己，以免打乱她的生活。

lines.en: Sometimes as a lamp. Sometimes as a bowl of fruit. Sometimes as a man planting a tree. Whatever he’d think of in the moment.
lines.zh: 有时候伪装成一盏灯。有时候伪装成一盘水果。有时候伪装成一个种树的男人。当时想到什么就变成什么。

lines.en: I suppose his story isn’t very important right now, though. This is.
lines.zh: 不过我想，他的故事此刻并不重要。这个才重要。
: 你……在做什么？……

lines.en: : Thank you for taking me home.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你送我回家。

lines.en: : You may seize your reward now.
lines.zh: : 你现在可以领取你的奖赏了。
: 奖赏就是我的身体。
: 你……不是 Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : What makes you say that, bro?
lines.zh: : 你为什么这么说，兄弟？

lines.en: : Are you the one who kissed me too?
lines.zh: : 刚才吻我的也是你吗？

lines.en: : I’m Tsuneyo Tojo — Samurai of Flavor and the Kendo Princess of the Golden Desert.
lines.zh: : 我是 Tsuneyo Tojo——风味之武士，黄金沙漠的剑道公主。

lines.en: : This isn’t what it’s like when...I black out too...is it?
lines.zh: : 这和我……昏过去的时候不一样……对吧？

lines.en: : I’m Tsuneyo Tojo — Samurai of Flavor and the Kendo Princess of the Golden Desert. Please plap plap me until I’m pregnant with your baby, bro.
lines.zh: : 我是 Tsuneyo Tojo——风味之武士，黄金沙漠的剑道公主。请啪啪啪地操我，直到我怀上你的孩子，兄弟。

lines.en: : Tempting, but...pass. I like when my partners are conscious and not weird paranormal entities, thanks.
lines.zh: : 挺诱人的，不过……免了。我喜欢的伴侣是清醒的，而不是什么诡异的超自然存在，谢谢。

lines.en: : This is not optional. Please plap plap me until I’m pregnant with your baby, bro.
lines.zh: : 这不是可选项。请啪啪啪地操我，直到我怀上你的孩子，兄弟。

lines.en: : Can you just go to your room or something? You’re tempting enough with your clothes on.
lines.zh: : 你能不能回你房间什么的？你穿着衣服就已经够诱人的了。

lines.en: : Plap plap plap. Fap fap fap. Let’s do it ‘til our bellies burst.
lines.zh: : 啪啪啪。撸撸撸。我们做到肚子炸开为止吧。

lines.en: : I’m like one more push away from abandoning the last sliver of morality I have left and just going for it.
lines.zh: : 我再被推一把，就要抛弃仅剩的那点道德，直接上了。

lines.en: : Plap plap plap. Fap fap fap. You know you want to fuck me, bro. I can hear the blood collecting in your cockdick. It’s like a pot of broth boiling over. Will you allow me to drink the excess fluid?
lines.zh: : 啪啪啪。撸撸撸。你想操我，兄弟，我知道。我能听见血正在你的鸡巴里汇聚。就像一锅汤煮沸溢出来。你愿意让我把溢出来的液体喝掉吗？

lines.en: : Can you...understand me at all? Like, is there even a point in trying to ask you questions right now? Or is all of this just some sort of...pre-programmed psychobabble?
lines.zh: : 你……到底能不能听懂我说话？就是说，现在问你问题还有意义吗？还是说这些都是某种……预设好的精神错乱胡话？
: 你有疑问？
: 很多。

lines.en: : Will you plap plap me if I answer them?
lines.zh: : 如果我回答了，你会啪啪啪地操我吗？

lines.en: : That...seems like a fair trade, sure. I was kind of hoping Tsuneyo would be Tsuneyo when I take her virginity, though.
lines.zh: : 那……听起来是笔公平的交易，行吧。不过我本来还挺希望夺走 Tsuneyo 初夜的时候，里面的人是 Tsuneyo 本人。

lines.en: : What do you want to know, bro? I’m not very smart. But I may be able to assist if it is in relation to noodlefoods.
lines.zh: : 你想知道什么，兄弟？我不太聪明。不过如果是和面条料理有关的，我也许能帮上忙。

lines.en: : You’re not...the same thing that takes control of me...are you?
lines.zh: : 你不是……那个控制我的东西……对吧？

lines.en: : This is my only body. It’s so hot. I need to be plap plapped to make it stop.
lines.zh: : 这是我唯一的身体。太热了。我需要被啪啪啪才能让它停下来。

lines.en: : Then...do you know anything about what Tsuneyo was saying earlier? About...uhh...
lines.zh: : 那么……你知道 Tsuneyo 之前说的那些事吗？关于……呃……

lines.en: : Do you...know a woman named Sekai?...
lines.zh: : 你……认识一个叫 Sekai 的女人吗？……

lines.en: : So good with her fingers. So good with traps. Wish it was me.
lines.zh: : 手指那么厉害。陷阱也那么厉害。真希望那是我。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. You are rubbing my penis now.
lines.zh: : 哦，好。你现在在摸我的鸡巴了。

lines.en: : Plap plap. I will prepare it for insertion.
lines.zh: : 啪啪啪。我会把它准备好，方便插入。

lines.en: : Can you just leave her alone, please? Possess me instead. I’m used to this sort of thing and deserve it. Tsuneyo’s totally innocent. Why should she have to suffer like this?
lines.zh: : 你能不能放过她，拜托？来附我的身吧。这种事我习惯了，也是我活该。Tsuneyo 完全是无辜的。她凭什么要受这种罪？
: 附你的身？

lines.en: : Yeah. There are plenty of girls who will happily fuck me whether I’m the one in my body or not. Then you could “plap plap” whenever you want. Plus, it’s been...kind of quiet lately.
lines.zh: : 对。不管在我身体里的是不是我，都有的是女孩乐意跟我上床。那样你想“啪啪啪”随时都行。而且，最近……还挺安静的。
: 安静？
: 在……我脑子里。
: 我要怎么附你的身？

lines.en: : You don’t know? Aren’t you some sort of...all powerful being? Who controls people for the sake of fulfilling some sort of vaguely worded sexual goal?
lines.zh: : 你不知道？你不是某种……全能的存在吗？为了某个措辞含糊的性目标而操控人的那种？
: 全能？

lines.en: : I just want to get plapped, bro.
lines.zh: : 我只是想被啪，兄弟。

lines.en: : Okay. I accept my fate. You’re stronger than me anyway, so resisting is pointless.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我认命了。反正你比我强，抵抗也没意义。

lines.en: : I’m going to have such a good first sex with you. I will remember it until I am not here anymore.
lines.zh: : 我会和你拥有一场极其美妙的初次性交。我会一直记着，直到我不在这世上的那一天。

lines.en: : Yeah, if you can make it so the host body has no recollection either, that’d be great.
lines.zh: : 行啊，如果你能让宿主的身体也什么都不记得，那就更好了。
: 啪啪啪。啪啪啪。啪——

lines.en: : Are we done? Is that all you wanted?
lines.zh: : 完了吗？你要的就这些？
: 有个 bug。
: 一个 bug？你在说什——
: Nao？……你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : I’m Tsuneyo Tojo — Samurai of Flavor and the Kendo Princess of the Golden Desert.
lines.zh: : 我是 Tsuneyo Tojo——风味之武士，黄金沙漠的剑道公主。
: 什么？不。不是说你。

lines.en: : This girl forced herself on me, passed out, got possessed, and now she’s trying to have sex with me. Not entirely in that order. Your turn.
lines.zh: : 这丫头先是对我动手动脚，然后昏倒，接着被附身，现在又想跟我上床。顺序大致如此。轮到你了。

lines.en: : Great. Well, once I’m done being sexually assaulted by another apparition, we can go to McDonald’s.
lines.zh: : 好极了。行，等我再被另一个幽灵性侵完，我们就可以去麦当劳了。

lines.en: : Please don’t write words like that.
lines.zh: : 别写那种字，拜托。

lines.en: : I don’t know. Maybe a few minutes? Maybe half an hour? Maybe longer?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。也许几分钟？也许半小时？也许更久？

lines.en: : Well, what do you want from me? Either wait or use your wizard powers to teleport us out of here. I can’t fight off a weirdly strong sex demon who wants to experience sex for the first time.
lines.zh: : 那你想让我怎么办？要么等着，要么用你的巫师法术把我们传送出去。我可打不过一个诡异又强壮、想体验第一次性爱的性欲恶魔。
: 啪啪啪，兄弟。
: 认真的？

lines.en: : Fine, fine. What use is doubting anyone’s ability when shit like this is happening to me every single day now?
lines.zh: : 行吧，行吧。既然这种事现在每天都发生在我身上，怀疑别人的能力又有什么用呢？
: 有什么东西……又来了……
: 我……能感觉到……啊……啊啊啊啊……啊啊啊啊啊……
: [[PRESSIGNORETOCONTINUEAAGHHH^%^$^$#83428572384!@$#&$(&!(*!)!!!!Fioguiorfgioewrfgio!!iojsdfdgiohsoifdyhwer8io!!!!]
: 刚才那他妈是什——
: 没有。

lines.en: : Just another boring day in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 不过是 Kumon-mi 又一个无聊的日子。
Nao 的好感度提升到了 [nao_love]！

lines.en: I called Tsuneyo on the way home.
lines.zh: 回家的路上，我给 Tsuneyo 打了电话。
她记得自己吻了我。

lines.en: Everything after that is a blur.
lines.zh: 之后的一切都是一片模糊。
晚安，月亮。
晚安，WORMGOD54。
Tsuneyo 的好感度提升到了 [tsuneyo_love]！
